title: Block Prices for Mileage Top-Ups on a Keyturn Trip Booking, by the Protection Election on the Trip
content:
The price of a priced block of included miles on a Keyturn Trip Booking turns on the guest's protection election for that trip. The election is made under the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan, and what is read is the protection level the election is written as, whether that election stands active, and the daily protection fees charged on it.

| The protection election standing on the trip | The block price |
|---|---|
| Written as Keyturn Business Traveler Protection, standing active, and the daily protection fees charged on it come to 2000.00 USD or more, however many lines they stand as and whenever they were raised | 125.00 USD |
| Written as Keyturn Declined Protection, or the election does not stand active | 165.00 USD |
| Any other case | The standard one |

### Which fees are counted

The fees counted are the daily protection fee lines raised on that election and those alone; a line raised on it for anything else — a young-driver protection surcharge, a level-change difference, an additional-driver fee, a deductible or a credit — is not a daily protection fee and is not counted.

The daily protection fee lines are counted however many lines they stand as and whenever they were raised, so several such lines raised on different days are added together and none of them is too old to count.

### Reading the table

The first row is a conjunction of three limbs and all three must hold together: the level, the active standing, and the daily protection fees. An election written as Keyturn Business Traveler Protection that stands active but whose daily protection fees come to 1850.00 USD does not reach the first row; nor does one whose daily protection fees come to 2400.00 USD but which no longer stands active. The fee threshold is reached rather than passed, so daily protection fees of exactly 2000.00 USD satisfy that limb.

The second row is a disjunction and either limb is enough: an election written as Keyturn Declined Protection, whatever its standing, and an election of any level that does not stand active, both give 165.00 USD.

### Hypothetical readings

*The trip carries an active election written as Keyturn Business Traveler Protection on which two daily protection fee lines of 1900.00 USD and 1200.00 USD have been raised on different days.* Taken together those are 3100.00 USD of daily protection fees, so all three limbs of the first row hold: the block price is 125.00 USD.

*The same election, where 1900.00 USD stands as a daily protection fee and a further 260.00 USD stands as an additional-driver fee.* Only the 1900.00 USD counts, which falls short of 2000.00 USD, so the first row is not reached and the block price is the standard one.

*The trip carries an active election written as Keyturn Premier Protection with 3100.00 USD of daily protection fees.* The level is not Keyturn Business Traveler Protection, so the first row fails; the level is not Keyturn Declined Protection and the election stands active, so the second row fails as well. The block price is the standard one.

*The trip carries an election written as Keyturn Premier Protection which does not stand active.* The second limb of the second row holds: the block price is 165.00 USD.
